findings.text: non-blocking: InFlightLine.emit has no production caller — git grep at 7dc1ca45a4 finds it referenced only from the new test — so the goal's "on the pane" half is unbuilt; the folded work is the follower's wait pass in reckon/crew_follow_commands.py, which the reviewed manifest already records under outside_scope.

non-blocking: IN_FLIGHT_PHASES restates the working-state set the module already imports as FLEET_WORKING_STATES (reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:1745) at ticker.py:865, so a state added to that owner will not reach the in-flight line without this literal being edited too.

non-blocking: _live_row hand-writes the live view's row keys instead of reading the view's declared field list (reckon/crew/query.py:100), so a key renamed there — "session" or "log_age_seconds", say — would leave the tests green while the line printed nothing or lost a column.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 8cc3363d73; one commit, three files, additions only — reckon/crew/ticker.py (+175), tests/test_the_pane_shows_its_work_in_flight.py (+155) and docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/pane-shows-work-in-flight.html (+24).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/test_the_pane_shows_its_work_in_flight.py driving a stubbed clock and live view; the file carries six cases covering every named behaviour, and I re-ran it at 7dc1ca45a4 in a scratch tree (6 passed).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to show the session's work in flight on the pane; reckon/crew/ticker.py:2842 adds InFlightLine, which composes exactly that line from the live view's rows, but no production caller exists, so nothing reaches a pane.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the reviewed run directory; status complete, commits 7dc1ca45a4, and it records the head gate (487 passed, EXIT=0), the base gate (481 passed, EXIT=0) and the negative control (5 failed, EXIT=1), all three present under gate/ and each ending in a bare EXIT= line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the run's recorded node.write_paths are reckon/crew/ticker.py, ticker.py, the landing fragment and the figures directory; the diff touches ticker.py, tests/test_the_pane_shows_its_work_in_flight.py and the fragment, so the test file lies outside the recorded list although the section's done-when names it as a write path, which the node's own manifest records under blockers.

justifications.durability: each assertion in tests/test_the_pane_shows_its_work_in_flight.py compares a literal the test did not hand in, so reverting _stream_age to _elapsed, dropping the cadence branch at reckon/crew/ticker.py:2912 or dropping the classification read at ticker.py:2840 reddens a named case, as the negative control's five failures show.
justifications.evidence: gate/head_ticker_importers.log (487 passed, EXIT=0) and gate/base_ticker_importers.log (481 passed, EXIT=0) measure the done-when's importer population, I reproduced the new test at 7dc1ca45a4 independently (6 passed), and ruff check and ruff format --check are clean on both staged Python files.
justifications.fit: the class follows the module's own idiom at reckon/crew/ticker.py:2813 and takes identity and width from Ticker at ticker.py:3020, though it reaches into the private _grid_width and _paint across a class boundary.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/ticker.py:2889 emits the line the section asks for, but nothing outside the new test calls InFlightLine.emit, so the pane the goal names shows nothing.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/ticker.py:2827 restates the working-state vocabulary that the same module already reads from FLEET_WORKING_STATES at ticker.py:865.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's three paths are all additions and the fragment carries only the landing record, but tests/test_the_pane_shows_its_work_in_flight.py is outside the run's recorded node.write_paths even though the section's done-when names it.
